seoTitle: Milwaukee Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: MPS Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Milwaukee Public Schools starts Sept. 1, 2026 and ends June 15, 2027. See MPS breaks, staff days, makeup dates, the official PDF, and an ICS download.
heroSummary: The first day of school for Milwaukee Public Schools is Tuesday, September 1, 2026, and the last day is Tuesday, June 15, 2027. MPS lists 176 student days and 191 staff days. Winter Break runs December 21 through January 1, and Spring Break runs March 26 through April 2. June 21–22 are reserved as emergency makeup days only if needed.

items: November 24 is a professional-development day when most staff report. November 25–27 are Thanksgiving Break, when students and school staff do not report.

groups.label: Schools may have additional no-school days
items: Individual schools may have additional no-school days that are not shown on the districtwide calendar. Check your school's calendar before making plans.

customSections.label: Summer Academy Was Extended Through July 31
customSections.content: The published 2026–27 calendar PDF originally lists 20 Summer Academy days from July 6–30 and July 31 as a staff record day. After Summer Academy closed on July 14–15 because of extreme heat, MPS extended the session through Friday, July 31 to make up missed time. Summer Academy remains separate from the district's 176-day regular student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Is this the Milwaukee or Minneapolis MPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers Milwaukee Public Schools in Wisconsin. Minneapolis Public Schools has a separate calendar page.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Milwaukee MPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for students is Tuesday, September 1, 2026. August 25–28 and August 31 are staff workdays, not student attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Milwaukee MPS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Classes resume Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Milwaukee MPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 26 through April 2, 2027. Classes resume Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Milwaukee MPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Tuesday, June 15, 2027. June 16 is a staff record day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are June 21–22 confirmed Milwaukee MPS school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. MPS reserves June 21–22 as emergency makeup days only if needed. They are excluded from this site's ICS download unless MPS activates them.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students attend MPS Parent-Teacher Conference Days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. MPS says students and staff do not report on the October 23 and March 25 conference days.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 13, 2026, against MPS's District Calendar page, published nine-language 2026–27 PDF, and later Summer Academy schedule update.
sourceReviewDetails: The English page of the PDF was checked for student dates, staff days, breaks, Summer Academy, and conditional emergency makeup dates; the other eight language pages were checked against it for matching districtwide dates.

Version note: The published calendar PDF lists Summer Academy on July 6–30, July 31 as a Summer Academy staff record day, and 20 Summer Academy days in total. MPS later closed Summer Academy on July 14–15 because of extreme heat and extended the session through July 31 to make up missed time. The district's live calendar now reflects the July 31 extension. This page uses the published PDF for the original district calendar and later MPS announcements for confirmed schedule changes.
